com.vector.cfg.persistency.groovy.api

Interface IPersistencyModelExportApi


  • @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
 @NotThreadSafe
public interface IPersistencyModelExportApi
    The IPersistencyModelExportApi API provides methods which allow to export model data.
    The modelExporty allows to export MDF model data into .arxml files. To access the export functionality use one of the getModelExport() or modelExport(Closure) methods.
    The advanced export use case provides access to multiple IPersistencyModelExportApi.IModelExporter for special export use cases like export the system description for the RTE.

    Normally you would retrieve an IPersistencyModelExportApi.IModelExporter by its ID via getExporter(String). On this exporter you can call:

    • IModelExporter#export(Object) to export the model
    • IModelExporter#exportAsPostBuildVariants(Object) to export the model divided into files per PostBuild predefined variant.

    You can retrieve a list of supported exporters from getAvailableExporter(). The list can differ from data loaded in your project.

    All method parameters and return values must be non-null unless documented otherwise.

      • exportPostBuildVariants

        @PublishedMethod
java.util.List<java.nio.file.Path> exportPostBuildVariants(java.lang.Object folder)
        Exports the PostBuild variants info.
        The method exportPostBuildVariants(Object) exports the PostBuild variants info. This will export the ActiveEcuc and miscellaneous data. The ActiveEcuC is exported into one file (even for split DPA-projects) per variant into <project-name>.<variant-name>.ecuc.arxml.

        Miscellaneous data is exported into one file per variant. The files contain all data of the project except:

        • ModuleConfigurations, ModuleDefinitions
        • BswImplementations, EcuConfigurations
        • Variant information like EvaluatedVariantSet
        The created files are <project-name>.<variant-name>.misc.arxml.

        The method returns a List<Path> of exported files.

        This method converts the supplied path same as the IAutomationPathsApi.resolvePath(Object) method.

        Parameters:
        folder - the folder
        Returns:
        the list
        Throws:
        PersistencyExportException - if the export can not be executed

      • withExporterArgs

        @PublishedMethod
<T> T withExporterArgs(java.util.Map<? extends java.lang.Object,? extends java.lang.Object> exporterArgs,
                                         @VDelegatesToWithClosureParam(value=IPersistencyModelExportApi.class)
                                         groovy.lang.Closure<T> code)
        Executes the code closure, with the exporterArgs passed to the method.

        You can use withExporterArgs(Map, Closure) to specify exporter arguments like in the command line with --exporterArgs argument. The key is the exporter ID, the value are the arguments to the exporter. See command line help for details.

        Type Parameters:
        T - the generic type
        Parameters:
        exporterArgs - the exporter args the map is converted to a Map
        code - the code
        Returns:
        return return type of the executed code block.
